headline: New fuel price hike expected for diesel! The critical hour has been revealed
summary: A diesel price increase of 6.62 lira per litre is expected in Turkey, with the net amount to be clarified on Monday, 14 September and reflected at pumps the next day. A possible tax change is also under discussion.
why: Fuel prices feed directly into transport and logistics costs and into Turkey's consumer inflation, which the central bank tracks closely.
